title: Insurance Claim Repairs Rate Card — Hourly Rates for Denied-Operation Work
content:
Labor on operations an insurer denied, performed at the customer's expense on an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order, is rated by the work the supplement added — the most recently decided supplement on the repair order.

| What that supplement added | Hourly rate |
|---|---|
| structural operations (with or without sensor calibrations) | frame-work rate, USD 118.00 |
| sensor calibrations, without structural operations | sensor-work rate, USD 115.00 |
| neither | body-shop rate, USD 104.00 |

**Clause.** A supplement adding structural operations takes the frame-work hourly rate of USD 118.00, a supplement adding sensor calibrations without structural operations takes the sensor-work hourly rate of USD 115.00, and any other supplement takes the body-shop hourly rate of USD 104.00.

### Notes to the card

1. The rate is read from what the supplement itself added, as its submission record shows, not from the repair class.
2. Structural operations govern: a supplement that added both structural operations and sensor calibrations takes USD 118.00.

### Hypothetical lookups

| Structural operations added | Sensor calibrations added | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | USD 118.00 |
| yes | no | USD 118.00 |
| no | yes | USD 115.00 |
| no | no | USD 104.00 |

At these rates, 2.0 billed hours come to USD 236.00 at the frame-work rate, USD 230.00 at the sensor-work rate and USD 208.00 at the body-shop rate.
